mapper.sql: p.id AS post_id, p.user_id, p.content, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.username, u.display_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes l WHERE l.post_id = p.id) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id) AS comment_count, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM likes l2 WHERE l2.post_id = p.id AND l2.user_id = #{currentUserId} ) AS liked_by_me
mapper.select: SELECT FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM posts WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
